content.text:
**Here are the 5 most notable recent tweets** (from the last few days, ~Aug 9–12, 2026) discussing x402 agent-payment adoption stats/growth numbers as fresh or breaking developments:

- **@NeuraCompute** (Aug 12): Highlights Base’s latest MCP/build-page numbers as proof the rails are converging fast — “75M+ agent transactions, 12K+ active agents, 22K+ x402 APIs, $24M in payment volume.” Calls MCP the on-ramp for real agent economic work.[[1]](https://x.com/NeuraCompute/status/2087633223220113552)

- **@FreeMoneyGL** (Aug 9): Shares adjusted “clean” vs. inflated protocol-wide stats — 169M total payments but only ~3.1M verified agent txns on Base in the trailing 30 days; notes Injective integration and XRPL’s 1.4M autonomous agent txns (127% jump since June). Questions which headline to trust.[[2]](https://x.com/FreeMoneyGL/status/2086421906966581603)

- **@RasikFardin** (Aug 9): Cites July 2026 settlement figure of just $238,084 across all x402 txns on 7 chains (avg payment $0.0396, down from $0.39 peak), alongside Visa/Mastercard/etc. joining the x402 Foundation on July 14. Frames the gap between rails and real commerce as the opportunity.[[3]](https://x.com/RasikFardin/status/2086453795064860778)

- **@raahulll_raj** (Aug 12): Summarizes late-April 2026 Coinbase-reported totals (165M txns, 69K active agents, ~$50M cumulative volume, Base ~85%) plus Chainalysis findings on memecoin farming distortion and the shift toward larger payments (> $1 now 95% of volume). Calls the autonomous rail narrative the key takeaway.[[4]](https://x.com/raahulll_raj/status/2087479314426302680)

- **@PayAINetwork** (Aug 9): Notes Visa & Artemis releasing adjusted agent-payment figures, Algorand’s x402 challenge crossing 160K+ txns, and MoonPay/PayBox enabling real in-chat buys — positions these as the latest audited ecosystem highlights.[[5]](https://x.com/PayAINetwork/status/2086449169649041474)

These posts stand out for tying specific, time-stamped growth metrics (transactions, agents, volume) to recent announcements or data releases.
